verdict.rationale: Dynadot documents its own transfer-in capability: a transfer landing page that mentions a 1-year renewal included with transfer, bulk transfer, and API-driven transfers. The evidence never describes the EPP/auth-code steps, transfer status tracking, the transfer price, or whether remaining registration time is preserved beyond the implied 1-year addition. The WHOIS Watchlist is a separate monitoring feature, not transfer tracking, so it earns no credit. missing for 10: documented EPP/auth-code flow, transfer status tracking, stated transfer cost, explicit handling of remaining registration time, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, transferring domains IN is documented and honest — EPP/auth-code flow, status tracking, what the transfer costs, and what happens to remaining registration time
